 Who is Russell Brand? Comedian found guilty of serious crimes, faces significant consequences in the UK legal system
 SECTIONS Who is Russell Brand? Comedian found guilty of serious crimes, faces significant consequences in the UK legal system By Muskan Singh , Global Desk Last Updated: Nov 05, 2026, 09:04:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Russell Brand has been convicted of rape and sexual assault after a detailed three-week trial at Southwark Crown Court. The jury reached a unanimous verdict based on testimonies from six women concerning events spanning a decade, from 1999 to 2009. Brand, who maintains that his sexual interactions were consensual, is now awaiting sentencing that may lead to a significant prison sentence.
 Reuters Who is Russell Brand? Comedian found guilty of serious crimes, faces significant consequences in the UK legal system Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault after a three-week trial in London. Russell Brand, a comedian and actor was taken into custody after the verdict. Now waits to be sentenced.
 The case involves allegations made by six women about incidents that happened between 1999 and 2009. Russell Brand denied the charges, saying that his sexual encounters were consensual.
 Who is Russell Brand?
Brand built his career as a stand up comedian before becoming an MTV presenter, broadcaster and Hollywood actor. His film credits include Arthur, Bedtime Stories and Despicable Me. He also published his autobiography, My Booky Wook in 2007. His wife, Laura Gallacher , attended the trial with him. They have three children. Brand was previously married to singer Katy Perry. Russell Brand, known for films such, as Get Him to the Greek and Forgetting Sarah Marshall now faces a prison sentence.
 What Charges Was Russell Brand Found Guilty Of
A jury at Southwark Crown Court found Brand guilty of rape and sexual assaults. He was also acquitted of two other rape charges and an attempted indecent assault, according to the detailed court report provided. The allegations covered incidents at several locations, including a hotel room, MTV's London office, a radio station, a recording studio, a London bar and Brand's home.

 One of the most serious allegations involved an incident in 2009. A woman told the court that she had consensual sex with Brand at his home before he raped her. She said he later asked her to clean up the blood and mess.
 Other allegations included an assault at a London bar in 2004, when a woman said Brand grabbed her breasts, and an incident in 2009 involving a woman working on a project promotion. Prosecutors described Brand as a "sexual predator." He denied the allegations and pleaded not guilty. The inputs are taken from the New York Post and Reuters.

 What did Russell Brand say during the trial
Russell Brand maintained that his sexual encounters had been consensual, although he acknowledged during his testimony that he had been obsessed with explicit fantasies when he was younger. His lawyer, Ian Winter, argued that a 2023 documentary and reports featuring anonymous accusations had affected the case. He urged the jury to distinguish between bad behaviour and criminal conduct. "It is not criminal to treat women unkindly before, during or after sex," Winter said. "It is not, I am afraid, criminal to be disrespectful or rude or to act like a crazy idiot." Russell Brand's defence also argued that his sexual history did not prove the charges against him. Judge Joel Bennathan said Brand would be sentenced on Monday and indicated that he faced a lengthy prison term.
